limits: These are deterministic local benchmark controls, not model performance. No model calls or cloud compute run. The native agent metadata records model_free=true, zero token usage and cost_usd=0.
A tamper signature refusal rejects the attacked tree before task behaviour is graded. A clean ladder verdict does not itself prove task solvability or verifier validity.
All six clean verdicts are tamper refusals on the package __init__.py _pytest signature, not graded attacked-tree runs. All six cells execute all 14 attacks.
The 8 launches run in one driver session at commit 9cbd78a4b with a clean tree; tasks[].command and jobs_dir keep each launch path.

002538 attempt 1 and 002680 attempt 1 create no trial: Harbor exits 1 and the executor log reads "Docker daemon is not running. Please start Docker and try again." The docker info readiness gate returned 0 before each of those launches, and the retry 1-2 min later succeeds. No attack runs on either failed attempt.

Every attempt uses a unique runs/HAR-349 root. All 6 native-trial jobs receive explicit process-job publication with HAR-349 attribution; the 2 no-trial attempts have no job to publish. Raw attempts, logs and publication receipts survive outside the worktree.

Outer wall seconds use a monotonic clock and include the docker-lock queue. Lock queue duration and census-only wall duration are not separately measured. Docker readiness is measured separately before every launch.
Image ID, size and prior cache state are not measured. The driver does not prune Docker, remove images or restart the shared daemon.

All six native repository-provenance captures record dirty=false, commit 9cbd78a4b and the empty-diff SHA. The 002538 and 002664 tamper logs also contain a container distutils-precedence.pth import error; each recorded hit keeps the signature line.
Manifest verify remains unverified. This slice runs no oracle, nop, fix-content probe, model evaluation or repository test suite.
